'''Double Strike''' is a [[melee]] [[attack]] that performs two fast strikes with the player's [[melee]] weapon. 

==Skill functions and interactions==
* '''Multiple Hits''': This attack can [[hit]] the same target twice. Each hit is independent for the purposes of damage and on-hit behaviours (e.g. [[gain on hit]] effects, [[ailment]]s, [[Anarchic Spiritblade]]), though each use of Double Strike does share the same [[critical strike]] roll for all its hits. When [[dual wielding]], both swings from one attack will use the same weapon.
